headline.waiting: Nothing is waiting for a human | 1 conversation is waiting for a human | {count} conversations are waiting for a human

subline.aiHandling: Hay.chat is handling {count} open conversation. | Hay.chat is handling {count} open conversations.

questions.title: Questions for the team
questions.description: The AI didn't know these and is checking with you. It keeps answering the customer's other questions meanwhile.
questions.statusOpen: The customer was told they'll hear back here in a few minutes.
questions.statusTimedOut: Waiting in your queue. The customer was told the team will reply.
questions.answerPlaceholder: e.g. Yes, the 40 cm vase ships in a gift box.
questions.rephraseHelp: The AI passes your answer on in the customer's language, using only what you wrote.
questions.asWrittenHelp: Your answer goes to the customer exactly as you wrote it.
questions.dismissedOpen: Question dismissed. The customer was told the team will reply, and the chat is in your queue.

answerPage.title: A customer is waiting on this question
answerPage.description: The AI of {organization} couldn't answer it and is checking with the team. Your answer goes to the customer in the chat.
answerPage.sentDescription: The customer gets your answer in the chat. You can close this page.
answerPage.unavailableTitle: This question can't be answered here
answerPage.alreadyHandled: Someone already answered or closed it.
answerPage.invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired.

row.noSummary: Summary not ready yet. Open the conversation to read it.

empty.title: All quiet
empty.description: When Hay.chat hands a conversation to a person it shows up here first. Turn on alerts to hear about it on this device.

push.description: Get a notification on this device whenever a conversation needs a human, even when Hay.chat isn't open. Alerts go to team members set to Available. If nobody answers within 10 minutes, Hay.chat alerts again, then sends an email.
push.testSentBody: It should appear on this device within a few seconds.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push alerts. On iPhone, add Hay.chat to your Home Screen first and open it from there.
push.unavailable: Push alerts are not set up on this Hay.chat server yet. Ask your administrator to add VAPID keys.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings. Allow them, then reload the page.
push.privacyLabel: Hide customer details on the lock screen
push.privacyHelp: Alerts only say "A customer needs a human". Open Hay.chat to see who it is. Applies to all your devices.
push.privacyOff: Alerts show the customer and summary

aiPause.title: Pause AI everywhere
aiPause.description: Stops every AI reply on every channel right away, including follow-ups and inactivity closes. Customers who write get one short message saying your team will reply, and their conversations wait here for you.
aiPause.perChannel: Turn the AI off on one channel only (drafts only)
aiPause.banner: The AI is paused everywhere. Your team answers every conversation.
aiPause.failed: Couldn't change the AI pause. Try again.

install.title: Get alerts on your iPhone
install.description: iPhone only shows Hay.chat alerts when Hay.chat is on your Home Screen. It takes three taps.
install.stepShare: In Safari, tap the Share button
install.stepAdd: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add"
install.stepOpen: Open Hay.chat from the new icon on your Home Screen and turn on alerts

spam.title: Spam
spam.description: Conversations held as spam. Hay.chat's AI doesn't answer them and they never count toward your bill.

empty.title: No spam
empty.description: When Hay.chat holds a conversation as spam it shows up here, so you can check it.

spam.notSpamReengaged: Moved out of spam. Hay.chat's AI is answering now.
spam.markSpamDone: Marked as spam. Hay.chat's AI won't answer it.

banner.title: Held as spam
banner.description: Hay.chat's AI isn't answering this conversation and it doesn't count toward your bill.
